title: Premium Billing Accounts Premium Accounting — Computing the Dental Tier-Difference Credit
content:
1. **The credit.** On Premium Billing Accounts, the tier-difference credit is the amount per month multiplied by the months counted, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure. The amount per month is the tier difference per month; the months counted are the months billed after the drop.

2. **The departed dependent.** The subscriber's child, spouse or domestic partner whose Dental PPO Plans enrollment funded by the account ended for loss of eligibility. Where more than one such enrollment is on record, it is the one with the latest termination date; of two with the same date, a child's before a spouse's or domestic partner's, and of two of one relationship the one recorded first. The tier billed before the drop is the coverage tier recorded on that dependent's enrollment.

3. **The tier after the drop and the plan.** Those recorded on the subscriber's active Dental PPO Plans enrollment funded by the account, taken as the one with the latest coverage effective date (of two with the same date, the one recorded first).

4. **Tier difference per month.** The plan's monthly premium for the tier billed before the drop less its monthly premium for the tier after the drop, never less than zero; it is zero where no departed dependent or no active subscriber enrollment is on record.

5. **Months billed after the drop.** The whole calendar months from the month after the month of the departed dependent's termination date through the last coverage month of the invoice issued last (of two issued on the same day, the one recorded first), that last month being the invoice's coverage month advanced by its months covered less one. They are zero when no departed dependent or no invoice is on record, or when that last month is not later than the termination month.

6. **Posting.** The credit is posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last.

**Worked example (hypothetical premiums).** The plan's monthly premium is 96.40 at member-and-spouse and 47.85 at member-only. A spouse's enrollment ended for loss of eligibility on 31 May; the subscriber's active enrollment is now member-only. Tier difference per month: 48.55. The invoice issued last covers 3 months starting with July, so its last coverage month is September. Months billed after the drop: June through September, 4. Credit: 48.55 multiplied by 4, 194.20, posted against July.
